A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RPE research despite the changed title. All pages, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–D support comparison; the missing sEH experiment in v2 is a substantive deletion, not an extraction gap.

before.justification: v1 reports original tabular validations and experiments on TFBind, RNA, QM9, and sEH, including supplementary comparisons in Appendix D.

after.justification: v2 retains original tabular validations and TFBind, RNA, and QM9 experiments, together with the supplementary comparisons in Appendix D.

M1.justification: Algorithm 3 retains the same reward scaling, flow-based value parameterization, uniform-policy evaluation, regression objective, and sampling-policy construction. Renaming RPE to Rectified Random Policy Evaluation and expanding its explanation do not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Section 5.4 and Appendix C remove the entire sEH ligand-generation task targeting protein affinity. Molecular evaluation consequently loses a distinct biological design objective and retains only QM9's orbital-energy-gap objective. TFBind, RNA, and the tabular tasks remain.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain FM-GFN, DB-GFN, TB-GFN, SubTB-GFN, Soft DQN, and M-DQN. Appendix D also retains the same uniform-backward-policy comparison. Deleting the complete sEH experiment does not change comparator membership within retained experiments.

E3.justification: The sEH-specific protocol disappears, including reward exponent 6 and mode-counting thresholds of 6.5 for reward and 2 for distance. Metrics, training budgets, and settings for retained experiments are unchanged; the revised wording about modified transition dynamics does not establish a new modification.

E4.justification: The tabular equivalence validations and Appendix D's comparison of learned versus uniform backward policies are retained with the same evidence. No ablation, robustness test, sensitivity analysis, or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions report three random seeds and means with standard deviations. The uncertainty-reporting practice, figure descriptions, and uncertainty entries in the retained RNA tables are unchanged.

E6.justification: v2 removes all sEH accuracy and mode-discovery curves from Figure 6, together with the finding that RPE discovers approximately twice as many modes on that task. All retained plotted results and both RNA tables are unchanged; no same-setting performance improvement is reported.

T1.justification: Section 2.1 newly supplies the explicit detailed-balance loss, previously only referenced through the trajectory-balance discussion. Theorems 4.1–4.2, the path-invariance assumption, and Appendix B's induction proof remain mathematically unchanged. The rewritten SubTB expression is algebraically equivalent.

C1.justification: Both versions claim a connection between uniform-policy values and GFlowNet flows, introduce RPE for reward matching, and report competitive benchmark performance. The revised title and emphasis on evaluating a fixed random policy restate the existing contribution.

C2.justification: v2 removes the proposed variance-reduction and child-state generalization explanations, retaining fixed-policy stability and simpler parameterization. It also reframes failure outside the path-invariance condition as a boundary of the established equivalence and a future research direction, replacing v1's broader characterization as a limitation of RL.

D1.justification: The sEH construction details, proxy-model description, and task-specific hyperparameters are removed. Implementation information for retained tasks, including the two-layer 2048-unit MLP, gradient clipping, RTX 3090 hardware, and baseline code references, remains unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds references on scientific discovery, temperature-conditional GFlowNets, energy decomposition, QGFN, and policy-gradient training, expanding the discussion of GFlowNet development. The Expected SARSA reference disappears with the variance discussion. The central positioning relative to MaxEnt RL remains.

P1.justification: The title, abstract, introduction, theoretical exposition, discussion, experiment narrative, and conclusion are extensively rewritten. Section 4 is reorganized and its separate benefits discussion compressed. Background explanations expand, while Appendix C inadvertently duplicates the baseline implementation paragraph.

P2.justification: Figure 6 loses its sEH panels. Algorithms 1–2 become full-width displays, Figure 1 moves out of wrapped text, and Figure 2 is enlarged. The RNA tables relocate without changing their structure or contents; retained plots preserve their curves, axes, and legends.

improvement.justification: v2 clarifies the uniform-policy connection and theorem premises and removes some speculative mechanism explanations. However, it withdraws the distinct sEH evaluation and its reproducibility details, reducing empirical breadth, and introduces a duplicated appendix paragraph. With the core method, proofs, and retained results unchanged, these explanatory benefits and evidential losses do not establish a reliable net improvement or deterioration.
